title: Neon Pulse — Episode 66: Shadow From The Past
description: Kael faces an unexpected adversary from his past inside the secret facility beyond the obsidian wall.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The blade stopped inches from my throat. When the figure stepped out of the shadows, my blood ran ice cold.
scenes.visual: Low angle medium shot inside a dark concrete chamber, the protagonist dodging a glowing steel blade, intense facial expression, dramatic blue rim lighting, smoke swirling on the floor.

scenes.narration: It was Marcus. My former mentor, the man who taught me everything, now standing among the enemy.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a stern older man with a cybernetic eyepatch holding a raised weapon, cold expression, flickering fluorescent overhead light casting harsh shadows in an industrial room.

scenes.narration: He didn't hesitate. A kinetic shockwave erupted from his fists, shattering the reinforced glass around us.
scenes.visual: Explosive wide shot of glass panels shattering inward, shards flying through the air in slow motion, silhouette of the protagonist recoiling backward from a powerful shockwave.

scenes.narration: I rolled beneath his strike, amber circuitry flaring along my sleeves as I channeled raw energy into my palms.
scenes.visual: Medium close-up of hands glowing with intense amber light, electrical sparks crackling along jacket sleeves, crouched combat stance on a grated metal floor.

scenes.narration: Our strikes collided with deafening force, sending blue and orange sparks cascading across the damp concrete floor.
scenes.visual: Action shot of two figures locking combat poles, bright energy sparks flying outward, dynamic camera angle, gritty texture on concrete walls in the background.

scenes.narration: He laughed, his voice echoing off the steel walls as he overpowered my stance and forced me to the edge.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of an adversary leaning forward with a smug smirk, pressing down a glowing weapon against the protagonist who is staggering backward near a sheer drop.

scenes.narration: With one final heave, I triggered the data crystal, unleashing a blinding pulse that overloaded every system in the room.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of a glowing data crystal held in a trembling hand, blinding white and amber light exploding outward, lens flare obscuring the background.

scenes.narration: In the chaos of the blackout, Marcus vanished into the smoke, leaving behind a coordinate map to something far worse.
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a ruined control room filled with thick grey smoke and blinking emergency red lights, the protagonist standing alone looking down at a holographic display map.

scenes.narration: The battle is just beginning. Follow along for more chapters in the ongoing saga.
scenes.visual: Cinematic medium portrait of the protagonist staring resolutely toward a distant glowing doorway, dark atmospheric background, subtle amber light reflecting in focused eyes.
